start.title: [TODO:it] Tears at Dawn
start.text:
[TODO:it] The tomb is open. He is gone.
Your tears fall on the cold stone.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Stay. Hope is closer than you know.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay and weep at the door

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Anger blinds the eyes to wonder.

run_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Flee
run_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Love does not run from an empty grave.
Linger. Something holy waits here.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay and weep at the door

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Anger
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] No hand stole Him. Be still.
Let your tears speak instead.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Stay and weep at the door

angels_ask.title: [TODO:it] Two in White
angels_ask.text:
[TODO:it] Two shining figures ask gently,
"Woman, why are you weeping?"

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Pride
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] This sorrow is not yours alone.
Speak simply. Tell them your grief.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Demand
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Heaven does not answer demands.
Speak softly. Let love show.

stranger.title: [TODO:it] Someone Behind You
stranger.text:
[TODO:it] You turn. A figure stands in soft light.
You think He is the gardener.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Listen. He is about to speak.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Speak to Him in plain hope
[TODO:it] Accuse Him of moving the body

ignore_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Turn Away
ignore_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He waits with patience for you.
Lift your eyes and speak.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Speak to Him in plain hope

accuse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Not Accusation
accuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Do not wound the stranger.
Ask simply, and you will be heard.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Speak to Him in plain hope
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Your words soften to a plea.

gardener_dialog.title: [TODO:it] Tell Me Where
gardener_dialog.text:
[TODO:it] "Sir, if you took Him, tell me where,
and I will carry Him away."

beg_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Be Still
beg_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Anger drowns the voice you long for.
Quiet your heart and listen.

walk_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Leave
walk_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] What you seek stands beside you.
Turn back. Be present.

name_called.title: [TODO:it] He Speaks Your Name
name_called.text:
[TODO:it] One word. Soft. Familiar.
"Mary." The world stops.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Reason it must be someone else

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust the Voice
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] No other voice has called you home.
Let your name reach your heart.

reason_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Beyond Reason
reason_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Some moments do not bend to logic.
Turn. See with your own eyes.

recognition.title: [TODO:it] Rabboni
recognition.text:
[TODO:it] It is Him. Alive. Radiant.
"Rabboni!" bursts from your lips.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Cling to Him with all your strength
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Joy does not need to grasp.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Faint and look away in fear
choices.feedback: [TODO:it] Lift your eyes. He is here.

cling_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Do Not Hold On
cling_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He says, "Do not cling to me.
I have not yet ascended."

faint_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Rise and See
faint_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He is not a ghost. He is risen.
Lift your eyes and meet Him.

do_not_cling.title: [TODO:it] Go to My Brothers
do_not_cling.text:
[TODO:it] "Go tell my brothers," He says.
"I ascend to my Father and yours."

choices.text: [TODO:it] Go at once with His message
[TODO:it] Argue they will not believe you

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] He Sends You
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] This joy is meant to be carried.
Go. The others wait in darkness.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Go at once with His message

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Tell Them Anyway
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Belief is not yours to give.
Your task is only to tell.

choices.text: [TODO:it] Go at once with His message

tell_disciples.title: [TODO:it] I Have Seen the Lord
tell_disciples.text:
[TODO:it] Hands trembling, you knock and speak:
"I have seen the Lord!"

pride_end_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Joy for All
pride_end_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] This morning belongs to everyone.
Give the news, not yourself.

choices.feedback: [TODO:it] You lower your voice in awe.

whisper_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Speak Clearly
whisper_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Hope must be heard to be carried.
Lift your voice. Tell them all.

ending.title: [TODO:it] He Is Risen Indeed
ending.text:
[TODO:it] He called your name. You are changed.
The morning belongs to hope.
